model.type: synthetic two-band spinless Haldane tight-binding; not ab-initio

conclusions: The spinless Haldane Hamiltonian is exactly C3-symmetric in the source gauge (orbital rotation identity; NN/NNN sums closed under 120 deg).
The Wannier90 HR cell-gauge representation transforms under C3 through the explicit center-embedding intertwiner W(k)=U^dag(C3 k)U(k) to machine precision.
m_z is an exact symmetry of the 2D spinless Wannier representation (no z hopping, in-plane centers, k_z-independent H). The combined Hamiltonian point group therefore contains C3h.
spglib resolves the synthetic marker POSCAR to -6 (C3h); the marker POSCAR is symmetry metadata only, and its structural -6 is consistent with the Hamiltonian-level C3h.

The frozen optical_response_invariants.json in-plane shift-current allowed coordinates are identical for C3 and C3h (6 components: xxx, xxy, xyy, yxx, yxy, yyy), and the NLO -6 classifier independent count (2) equals the C3h dimension (2).
Stage 23's structural criterion POSCAR_point_group_is_C3 is superseded by this Hamiltonian-level gate; the in-plane tensor selection is valid, while the 3D -6 vs 3 difference remains documented.
limitations: This gate verifies Hamiltonian symmetry and in-plane tensor selection rules for the synthetic model only; it does not verify any response spectrum.
Out-of-plane components (forbidden by m_z for shift current in this model) were not screened.
C3h vs C3 differ in their full 3D tensor spaces; only the 2D in-plane response is physically relevant here and it is identical for both.
